verdict.rationale: Skyvern is an API-driven browser-automation platform with an MCP server, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions API key scoping, per-agent keys, or permission controls. Its credential features cover storing website login credentials and password-manager integrations for the automations themselves, not restricting the agent's access to the Skyvern API.
